title: Mistral AI Releases Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk): A 1.05T Parameter Multimodal MoE Model
summary: Mistral AI has released Mistral Large 4, nicknamed Le Chonk, as a public preview. It is a 1.05 trillion parameter Mixture of Experts model with 49 billion active parameters, native image input, and a 1 million token context window, trained on 3,800 NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GPUs in Mistral's own European datacenters. The API is live now; open weights ship end of October 2026. The post Mistral AI Releases Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk): A 1.05T Parameter Multimodal MoE Model appeared first on MarkTechPost .
title_en: Mistral AI Releases Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk): A 1.05T Parameter Multimodal MoE Model
title_zh: Mistral AI发布Mistral Large 4（Le Chonk）：1.05万亿参数多模态MoE模型
summary_en: Mistral AI launched Mistral Large 4, a 1.05T-parameter multimodal MoE with 49B active parameters, native image input, and 1M-token context, trained on 3,800 NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GPUs in European datacenters. API is live; open weights arrive end of October 2026.
summary_zh: Mistral AI发布Mistral Large 4，1.05万亿参数多模态MoE模型，激活参数490亿，支持原生图像输入和100万token上下文，在欧洲数据中心用3800块NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GPU训练。API已上线，开放权重将于2026年10月底发布。

title: EmbeddingGemma 2: an open, lightweight multimodal embedding model
title_en: EmbeddingGemma 2: an open, lightweight multimodal embedding model

summary_zh: 谷歌DeepMind发布EmbeddingGemma 2，一款开源轻量级多模态嵌入模型，支持文本与图像任务的高效部署。

title: AI computing startup Lambda to raise $4B ahead of planned IPO
summary: Nvidia-backed Lambda is raising up to $4 billion at a $14.5 billion pre-money valuation ahead of a planned 2027 IPO, led by Coatue and Blackstone.
title_en: AI computing startup Lambda to raise $4B ahead of planned IPO
title_zh: AI计算初创公司Lambda拟融资40亿美元，筹备IPO
summary_en: Nvidia-backed Lambda is raising up to $4 billion at a $14.5 billion pre-money valuation ahead of a planned 2027 IPO, led by Coatue and Blackstone.
summary_zh: 英伟达支持的Lambda正以145亿美元投前估值融资至多40亿美元，由Coatue和黑石领投，为2027年IPO做准备。

title: The next hurdle for AI agents: getting websites to let them in
summary: Personal AI agents promise to shop, book flights, and make reservations for you. But deliberate blocks and anti-bot defenses are getting in the way, leaving consumers caught in the middle. A new standard aims to help.
title_en: The Next Hurdle for AI Agents: Getting Websites to Let Them In
title_zh: AI代理的下一个障碍：让网站放行
summary_en: Personal AI agents promise to shop, book flights, and make reservations, but deliberate blocks and anti-bot defenses stand in the way, leaving consumers caught in the middle. A new standard aims to help.
summary_zh: 个人AI代理承诺代购、订机票和预订，但网站故意封锁和反机器人防御阻碍其运行，消费者陷入两难。一项新标准旨在解决此问题。

title: Google DeepMind Releases EmbeddingGemma 2, a 740M Open Multimodal Embedding Model Built on Gemma 4
summary: Google DeepMind's EmbeddingGemma 2 maps 5 input types into one 768d space and ships today under Apache 2.0. The post Google DeepMind Releases EmbeddingGemma 2, a 740M Open Multimodal Embedding Model Built on Gemma 4 appeared first on MarkTechPost .
title_en: Google DeepMind Releases EmbeddingGemma 2, a 740M Open Multimodal Embedding Model Built on Gemma 4
title_zh: 谷歌DeepMind发布EmbeddingGemma 2：基于Gemma 4的740M开源多模态嵌入模型
summary_en: Google DeepMind released EmbeddingGemma 2, a 740M open multimodal embedding model built on Gemma 4, mapping five input types into one 768-dimensional space under Apache 2.0.
summary_zh: 谷歌DeepMind发布EmbeddingGemma 2，这是一个基于Gemma 4构建的740M开源多模态嵌入模型，可将五种输入类型映射到统一的768维空间，采用Apache 2.0许可。

title: Google is about to remove free access to Gemini Flash and Pro
summary: Starting on October 9th, anyone using Google Gemini on a free plan will be limited to the Flash Lite model. Free users can currently choose from Gemini Flash Lite, Flash, and Pro, but now you'll need a $4.99/month Google AI Plus subscription to access the standard Flash model. However, that subscription is also getting a […]
title_en: Google to Remove Free Access to Gemini Flash and Pro
title_zh: 谷歌将取消Gemini Flash和Pro的免费访问
summary_en: Starting October 9th, free Google Gemini users will be limited to the Flash Lite model. Access to the standard Flash model will require a $4.99/month Google AI Plus subscription, which is also being updated.
summary_zh: 从10月9日起，谷歌Gemini免费用户将只能使用Flash Lite模型。访问标准Flash模型需要每月4.99美元的Google AI Plus订阅，该订阅也将更新。

title_zh: Musubi发布PolicyLM-1.7B，用于实时内容审核

summary_zh: Musubi发布轻量级开放权重决策模型PolicyLM-1.7B，专为实时内容审核设计，旨在改变AI决策模型执行政策的方式。

summary_zh: Meta与OpenAI董事长Bret Taylor的初创公司Sierra合作，制定技术标准以简化与AI机器人的商业交互，旨在减少AI驱动商业中的混乱。

title: We can’t just change the definition of ‘recording’
summary: With AI hardware, tech companies are pushing the definition of what does and doesn't constitute a recording. For most of gadget history, it'd be reasonable to assume that a device with a microphone or camera is either recording you or it isn't; it's either on or off, without much gray area. Microphones capture sound. Cameras […]
title_en: We Can't Just Change the Definition of 'Recording'
title_zh: 我们不能随意改变“录音”的定义
summary_en: Tech companies are redefining what counts as a recording with AI hardware, blurring the line between on and off. The Verge argues this shift threatens user privacy and consent.
summary_zh: 科技公司借助AI硬件重新定义“录音”概念，模糊设备开关界限。《The Verge》认为这一转变威胁用户隐私与知情同意。

title: Anthropic is giving startups a free year of Claude Team and $1,000 in credits

title: LibreOffice says ‘no AI’ is now a software feature
summary: The maker of the open source document editor says it has no plans to add AI to its software's default configuration, citing user privacy.
title_en: LibreOffice says 'no AI' is now a software feature
title_zh: LibreOffice称“无AI”现已成为一项软件特性
summary_en: LibreOffice's maker says it has no plans to add AI to its default configuration, citing user privacy, positioning the absence of AI as a deliberate feature.
summary_zh: LibreOffice开发商表示，出于用户隐私考虑，没有计划在默认配置中加入AI，将“无AI”定位为一项有意为之的特性。
